![13 Amazing Things to do in Kanchanaburi Province - The Lost ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07262343-1672-0139-0000-6d3643c8e67e:4)
Top things to do in Kanchanaburi include visiting the [Bridge on the River Kwai](https://www.viator.com/en-GB/Kanchanaburi/d22285) , exploring Erawan National Park , and walking the [Death Railway](https://www.getyourguide.com/kanchanaburi-l32274/ttd/) . This historic and scenic province in western Thailand offers powerful WWII history, gorgeous nature, and cultural landmarks.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g297924-Activities-Kanchanaburi_Kanchanaburi_Province.html) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g297924-Activities-Kanchanaburi_Kanchanaburi_Province.html)[[2]](https://www.magnificentworld.com/10-things-to-do-in-kanchanaburi/)[[3]](https://www.viator.com/en-GB/Kanchanaburi/d22285)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jEfECmFRV_A&t=3)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V3QhjhUKLCU&t=39)

Historical Sites

- **Bridge on the River Kwai:** Walk across this famous historical landmark built during World War II.
- **Death Railway & Tham Krasae:** Ride the historic train along the wooden trestle bridge hugging the cliffside.
- **Hellfire Pass:** Walk the deep mountain rocky cutting carved by hand by prisoners of war , and visit the informative memorial museum.
- **War Cemeteries:** Pay respects at the peaceful Kanchanaburi War Cemetery (Don-Rak) near the town center.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g297924-Activities-Kanchanaburi_Kanchanaburi_Province.html) [[1]](https://www.uhotelsresorts.com/uinchantreekanchanaburi/attractions)[[2]](https://www.getyourguide.com/en-gb/kanchanaburi-l32274/ttd/)

Nature and Wildlife

- **Erawan National Park:** Hike up the famous seven-tiered emerald-green waterfall and swim in the clear tropical pools.
- **ElephantsWorld:** Visit this ethical, non-riding sanctuary dedicated to caring for rescued, old, and disabled elephants.
- **Sai Yok Waterfalls:** Explore nearby national parks featuring scenic cascades right by the river.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g297924-Activities-Kanchanaburi_Kanchanaburi_Province.html) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SjcCsfSsacU&t=277)[[2]](https://www.travelsewhere.net/places-visit-kanchanaburi-thailand/)[[3]](https://www.thelostpassport.com/kanchanaburi-travel-guide/)

Culture and Local Sights

- **Wat Tham Suea (Tiger Cave Temple):** Climb up to see the massive golden Buddha statue and tall pagoda with views over the rice fields.
- **Kanchanaburi City Skywalk:** Stroll along the 150-meter elevated glass pathway for views of the river junction at sunset.
- **Floating Resorts:** Stay overnight in a traditional floating raft house directly on the River Kwai.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g297924-Activities-Kanchanaburi_Kanchanaburi_Province.html) [[1]](https://www.facebook.com/TheNationThailand/posts/how-to-spend-a-day-in-kanchanaburifrom-scenic-views-to-therapeutic-activitiesyou/906460248173977/)[[2]](https://worldtravelfamily.com/things-to-do-in-kanchanaburi/)
